validate_skill_frontmatter: validate a skill directory's SKILL.md frontmatter and return validity status with error messages
check_allowed_frontmatter_properties: check that SKILL.md frontmatter contains only allowed keys from the permitted set
validate_skill_name_format: validate a skill name follows hyphen-case convention with lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens
validate_skill_description: validate a skill description is a string under 1024 characters without angle brackets
parse_yaml_frontmatter: parse YAML frontmatter from SKILL.md and return a dictionary or error message
